newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1996 cars sales jump 24.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1996 cars sales jump 24.5 pct.

text.p: Philippine car sales jumped by 24.5 percent to 88,648 units in 1996 from the year-ago 71,195, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc (CAMPI) said on Wednesday.
The industry group said Honda Cars Phils Inc, a unit of Japan's Honda Motor, sold the most number of cars with 20,233 units, followed by Toyota Motor Phils, a unit of Toyota Motor Corp, with 19,814.
Mitsubishi Motor Phils, a unit of Mitsubishi Motors Corp, sold 14,944 while Nissan Motor Phils Inc, a unit of Nissan Motor Co Ltd, sold 12,134.
The local assembler of Malaysia's Proton cars sold 13,908 units.
